newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine car output slips on July, up on Aug '95.
newsitem.headline: Argentine car output slips on July, up on Aug '95.

text.p: Argentine auto production for August totalled 30,500 units, down 2.3 percent from July but up 28.6 percent on August last year, the industry association ADEFA said Thursday.
Domestic sales of Argentine cars of 17,503 units were 0.8 percent up on the previous month and 22.8 percent higher than in August 1995.
Argentine car exports were 11,093, a 23.3 percent drop on July but a 179.4 percent increase compared to August 1995.

ADEFA that said over the first eight months of this year versus the same period of 1995, auto production showed a 3.6 percent drop, domestic sales showed a 4.3 percent increase and exports showed an 84.3 percent increase.
